title.narrative: Scaling up innovation to optimize HIV prevention services and community engagement to catalyze the HIV response in Suriname. - Suriname (01-Apr-2025-31-Dec-2027)

description.narrative: Suriname, HIV, Ministry of Health, Welfare and Labour (MOH)This program has the following goals: Accelerate Prevention to Reduce New HIV Infections. Reduce Morbidity and Mortality by Providing Treatment, Care and Adherence Support for All PLHIV. ¬†Improve HIV Resource Acquisition and Allocation. Strengthen Program Management and Response to Ensure Equity, Human Rights and Sustainability. Strengthen Strategic Information to Guide Progress Toward Achievement of NSP Goals ¬†. The objectives of this program are: Enhance testing services. Scale up national prevention efforts. Reach key and vulnerable populations with customized interventions. Intensify response in order to achieve and maintain the elimination of mother-to-child transmission of HIV, syphilis and hepatitis B. Maximize treatment coverage for PLHIV. Provide the highest quality treatment and care for PLHIV. Provide appropriate treatment for PLHIV with co-morbidities. Increase resources for HIV programming (resource acquisition). Improve efficient and effective allocation and use of programme resources. Strengthen human resource for HIV program management. Strengthen multi-sectoral engagement/roles and relationships to address social and structural drivers of HIV. Zero discrimination in all settings
